facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports that Malawi 'has initiated regional consultation workshops to develop' its 'first-ever' National Digital Transformation Strategy (and National AI Strategy), led by the Department of E-Government with UNDP and the Public Private Partnership Commission; the strategies are to be blueprints 'across all sectors of the economy', with improved public service delivery; no adopting act is named, and the date is the article's publication date (2025-09-25) as the workshops' own date is not given.

Regional consultation workshops to develop the National Digital Transformation Strategy were launched in September 2025 (reported 2025-09-25), led by the Department of E-Government with UNDP (Inclusive Digital Transformation for Malawi) and the PPP Commission (Digital Malawi Acceleration Project).

systems.owner: Department of E-Government, with UNDP and PPPC
systems.tiers: national; blueprint for a digital economy and service delivery across all sectors; called 'first-ever'
